title: 协议视图与 Raw：定位一次 call id 异常

audiences: 正在排查模型请求或兼容层异常的开发者
需要核对自研 Harness 工具关联的作者
想理解协议视图、Raw 搜索与 provenance 分工的 PMA 用户
teaching_contract.question: 摘要只能看到失败时，怎样定位错误原始字段，并用修正后的请求验证结论？
teaching_contract.takeaway: 先在时间线定位 Request 2，再用协议视图确定异常位于 input，使用 Raw 搜索比较 call id，打开 Response 原文读取 invalid_tool_output 与 HTTP 400，检查 exact provenance，最后用 Request 3 验证修正。
explicit_limits: The compatibility_note is an intentionally synthetic, non-standard input item. It is unknown-schema evidence, not the asserted cause of the HTTP 400.
OpenAI Responses function_call and function_call_output are typed Items correlated by call_id; Viewer-added assistant/tool labels are semantic projections, not native wire roles on those Items.
The deterministic upstream intentionally rejects the mismatched call id; this is not a provider incident.
Raw search is scoped to the selected Request and section, not the whole Source.
Exact capture fidelity proves artifact preservation and lifecycle association, not semantic correctness of the client request.
The fixture demonstrates Viewer diagnosis behavior, not remote model quality.

facts: Request 1 returns a list_directory function_call with call_id call_list_directory.
Request 2 sends function_call_output with call_id call_list_direct0ry and one intentionally synthetic compatibility_note item whose schema is unknown to the protocol projector.
The deterministic upstream rejects Request 2 with HTTP 400, code invalid_tool_output, and param input[3].call_id.
Request 3 restores call_list_directory, removes the unknown fixture item, and receives the final Assistant response.
The failed Request appears in the expanded background-request timeline rather than disappearing behind the successful final answer.
Both request and response provenance report fidelity exact and capture_lifecycle association confidence exact.
The placeholder authorization header is persisted as [REDACTED:header].

visual_review.raw_frame_result: passed for exact 1920x1080 dimensions, full three-pane layout, Codex theme, readable right-pane tabs, and fixed disposable paths
visual_review.annotation_result: passed: all 20 timeline-declared states were regenerated as JPEG and inspected at exact 1920x1080 and 1024x576; badges are centered, subtitles remain bottom-centered, focus regions do not cover evidence, and no arrows are required
review_notes: The first overview and protocol recapture were rejected because a Raw query persisted after changing sections and because the active Request had changed to Request 3.
Both frames were re-recorded only after clearing search, reopening Request 2, and asserting the right-pane h2 before capture.
The Response frame uses the explicit source/original display mode so the HTTP error body is visible instead of the organized empty-message state.

After the protocol wording changed, the first 1024x576 recapture of 02b was rejected because the browser compositor had not settled after resizing from 1920x1080; the frame was re-recorded only after asserting a 1024x576 viewport and full-canvas visual bounds.
No arrows are used because the right-pane search results and numbered focus regions already provide direct spatial correspondence.

Progressive states were checked individually: the next number appears only after the previous point has been explained; a previous number either exits for an independent focus or remains dimmed for a comparison.
The launch-style v0.2 outro combines provenance and correction verification into one final beat, keeping the diagnostic sequence to four scan-friendly steps at both review sizes.
The early palette PNG review set was replaced with the current generator's JPEG output so future capture commands no longer create duplicate filename stems.
Tracked review proxies use JPEG quality 70 to keep the full demo catalog below its media budget; the eight lossless original Source frames remain unchanged and are the fidelity reference.

video_master.stream: H.264 video only; no audio stream, subtitle stream, or webpage subtitle layer
video_master.comparison_reference: fresh 1920x1080 JPEG review capture rendered from the exact source timeline; reproducible with capture-storyboard-review-frames.mjs
video_master.comparison_crop: 1920x900, excluding the approved webpage-subtitle region because the picture master intentionally hides that layer
qa_notes: All 20 timeline review points were re-extracted from the final MP4 and visually inspected at original size.
Twenty-seven additional frames cover every scene boundary before the transition, during the crossfade, and after the new scene settles; no blank or displaced state was found.

The first comparison against older palette-compressed tracked PNGs produced a misleading 5.455/255 mean difference. A fresh reproducible JPEG review capture reduced this to 0.421/255 and confirmed identical geometry.
The maximum frame-mean difference occurs on the unannotated outro card and was confirmed as normal browser/encoder rendering variation rather than an offset or missing element.
The unknown schema item, mismatched call id, HTTP 400, exact provenance, corrected call id, and final completed response all remain readable without webpage subtitles.
